io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes

Class DataTypeMethods

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes.DataTypeMethods

  • public final class DataTypeMethods
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe persistent-data helpers keyed by plain Strings.

    The legacy implementation routed through org.bukkit.persistence.* (1.14+) which the JVM verifier links at enable, breaking 1.8. Every value is now stored as a flat String-keyed entry through PersistentDataAPI, so no org.bukkit.persistence.* type appears in bytecode.
